name: kettlebell sitting tibialis press
description: A seated press that lifts a kettlebell on the top of the foot to strengthen the muscles at the front of the shin.
instructions: Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.
